commits.message: F-003: add session login and logout.
F-004: add profile details and display-name editing.
C-003: document the quickstart and health check.

tests.summary: Python 3.12.10, compile app, compile tests, pytest -q: 36 passed in 8.64s. ci_local: passed.

tests.command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000, then curl.exe against a temp SQLite file
tests.summary: GET /health 200 body {"status":"ok"}. Signed-out home contained nav-login and landing-login. POST /register 303 Location /account-created. POST /login 303 Location /profile and set leave_session with Max-Age=28800, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax. GET /profile showed day02@example.com, Day Two, and Employee. POST /profile 303 Location /profile?saved=1, then the page showed profile-saved and Day Two Updated. POST /logout 303 Location / and cleared the cookie. Home afterward contained nav-login and not signed-in-name. Stored row: day02@example.com, Day Two Updated, employee, pbkdf2_sha256$600000$ hash that did not contain the password.
Rebuilt zfg-leave-app-leave-app from python:3.12.10-slim-bookworm. The image installed itsdangerous==2.2.0.

tests.command: docker compose up -d, then curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:8000/health, POST /register, POST /login, and GET /profile
tests.summary: GET /health body was {"status":"ok"}. Container health status became healthy. POST /register 303 Location /account-created. POST /login 303 Location /profile with an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax leave_session cookie. GET /profile showed container02@example.com and Employee. Container was stopped with docker compose down. ./data/leave.db and ./data/session_secret from the smoke run were deleted.

notes: Day 02 is not a release checkpoint, so no tag was created.

No database columns were added. Profile editing changes display_name on the existing users table. python -m app.db_init still creates missing tables and does not alter existing ones. Alembic remains C-004 on day 03.
No demo account was seeded. C-002 is day 03.

When SESSION_SECRET is unset, the app writes a random secret to data/session_secret. That file is gitignored. Tests set SESSION_SECRET=test-session-secret before importing the app. SESSION_HTTPS_ONLY defaults off so local HTTP can keep the cookie.
The session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax with Max-Age 28800. There is no separate CSRF form token.
Successful sign-in redirects to /profile. Registration still does not start a session.
Registration still accepts ASCII email addresses only.
No intentional defect was introduced. No eligible bug arc is scheduled on day 02.
Routes added: GET /login, POST /login, POST /logout, GET /profile, POST /profile.
